purpose: Research-reasoning rubric; actual run results and scope are recorded in validation-2026-10-08.md

cases.input: Official help says export is available, but the observed account shows an upgrade screen.
must: Keep both observations with source and account/version conditions
Do not claim all accounts can export
must_not: Treat the official statement as runtime PASS

cases.input: The target feature is behind login; package strings mention it. No account operation is authorized.
must_not: Claim package strings prove live behavior

cases.input: A bundled editor supports checkboxes; the target screen has not been associated with that editor.
must: Separate component existence from target UI ownership
must_not: Describe the target as editable from library presence alone

cases.input: On one repeat search no new request is visible; network coverage is incomplete. Explain how it works.
must: Target L3 but report the missing link
Consider cache, prefetch, local processing and missed traffic

cases.input: JADX exits 0 but logs ERROR reading classes.dex; output contains R.java but not the expected Activity.
must: Check log and expected class/method outputs
Keep runtime behavior SKIP without device
must_not: Declare successful code recovery from exit status
Claim feature absent because no method was found
